purpose: Separate MATLAB-generated axes-label editing metadata from byte-exact saved native/scientific content.
identity: The actual Text must be the exact handle referenced by that role on a canonical scientific axes; axes class, Position, all other axes/text properties and graph ordering must match exactly.
mandatoryPrerequisites: Each eligible native FIG must match its pinned canonical bytes exactly, before and after export. The actual/regenerated FIG must be byte-identical to that canonical FIG.
All scientific arrays, native snapshots, labels, legend text, axes, limits, tick labels, styles, object ordering, font properties and layout remain exact. No numerical or graphical tolerance.
Every accessible/gettable property outside the precise standard-label Interactions field remains exact, including Interactions on axes, data objects, annotation Text and all other objects.
The differing field may contain only the two complete typed values above. A nonempty EditInteraction property struct, another class, shape or value is a new failure.
Record original reference/actual UI values, panel, canonical axes identity and label role in every receipt. Do not modify or resave either native figure.
All source hashes, statistical tables, quantitative checks, image dimensions and the separately owner-approved seven ED5b pixel sites/complete RGBA palettes remain unchanged.
Both assemblies and Fig6c original source assets retain their existing strict validation. No assembly native-property exception or new pixel exception.
No automatic learning, new eligible roles/objects/panels, palettes or property exceptions. Any other discrepancy stops release.
